question: I'm a CS 5th-year student (P-046) on academic warning. I've been offered a semester exchange at CMU Pittsburgh. Am I eligible to participate?

domain_contributions.policies: Academic warning explicitly prohibits study abroad and campus exchange programs: 'A student on an academic action cannot overload, study abroad, or take independent studies'
domain_contributions.programs: P-046's academic standing = academic warning (confirmed from record)

key_facts: CMU-Q policy: academic warning prohibits study abroad and by extension campus exchange programs
The prohibition applies until P-046 returns to good academic standing
Even an exchange within CMU (Pittsburgh campus) is likely subject to this restriction
P-046 must first resolve the academic warning before any exchange/study abroad option
wrong_if_single_domain: Knowing only the programs domain (P-046's courses, standing) identifies the AW status but doesn't detail the specific prohibition on campus exchange. Only the policies domain provides the explicit rule that AW blocks this type of program.
common_mistake: Distinguishing between 'study abroad' and 'campus exchange within CMU' and assuming the exchange is permitted; not knowing the AW prohibition extends to all study-away programs
reasoning_chain: Step 1 (programs): P-046 is on academic warning
Step 2 (policies): AW = cannot study abroad / participate in campus exchange
Conclusion: P-046 is not eligible for the CMU Pittsburgh exchange while on academic warning
